commit.message:
docs: correct README Key Capabilities accuracy and diagram completeness

- Reframed the fabricated "group existing shapes with GroupShape" claim.
  GroupShape is a sealed, empty class implementing no members -- it does not
  even implement IGroupShape, so it exposes no Shapes collection. It is only
  ever constructed internally by ShapeFactory when parsing a pre-existing
  <p:grpSp> element on load. The claim now correctly describes read-only
  recognition of existing groups, not creation.
- Fixed the Images.AddImage() misattribution. Images (the static factory
  class) only has FromFile()/FromStream(); AddImage() is a real method, but
  it lives on ImageCollection (reached via Presentation.Images), with return
  type IPPImage, not IImage. Corrected in both Key Capabilities and the API
  Reference Detailed Member Reference table, which previously contradicted
  the file's own class-summary table.
- Corrected the text-formatting capability description, which covered only
  character-level formatting. Real ParagraphFormat (alignment, spacing,
  indentation, margins) and TextFrameFormat (margins, wrap, anchoring,
  columns, autofit) both exist and are reachable via Paragraph.ParagraphFormat
  and TextFrame.TextFrameFormat -- the bullet now covers all three real
  formatting levels the library actually supports.
- Corrected the At a Glance diagram, which was missing 3D formatting
  entirely despite it being a real, documented capability (ThreeDFormat --
  bevel, camera, light rig, material, extrusion depth), and had lumped
  visual effects into a single fill/line/effect node. Restructured to 8
  nodes matching the real capability boundaries already documented in Key
  Capabilities.

Verification: every class/method claim above was independently confirmed
against the real, current source (GroupShape.cs, IGroupShape.cs, Images.cs,
ImageCollection.cs, IImageCollection.cs, ParagraphFormat.cs,
TextFrameFormat.cs, ThreeDFormat.cs, EffectFormat.cs) before being added or
changed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
